name: retail-banking-mfe
description: Retail internet banking micro-frontend demo: Vite + React + TypeScript + Bootstrap + Module Federation, axios API layer and route guards

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n api,accounts,cards,utility,transfer,benef,shell -c gray,blue,magenta,yellow,cyan,green,red "npm run api" "npm run dev:federated -w @bank/accounts" "npm run dev:federated -w @bank/cards" "npm run dev:federated -w @bank/utility" "npm run dev:federated -w @bank/transfer" "npm run dev:federated -w @bank/beneficiary" "npm run dev -w @bank/shell"
scripts.preview:all: npm run build && concurrently -k -n api,accounts,cards,utility,transfer,benef,shell -c gray,blue,magenta,yellow,cyan,green,red "npm run api" "npm run preview -w @bank/accounts" "npm run preview -w @bank/cards" "npm run preview -w @bank/utility" "npm run preview -w @bank/transfer" "npm run preview -w @bank/beneficiary" "npm run preview -w @bank/shell"
